div.div: One submitted job passes through both layers. Layer 1 answers when a job may start. Layer 2 answers which pool queue runs each task and when. The scheduler holds no backlog of its own: the topology scout showed an in-memory backlog and capacity ledger overran its cap and inverted priority after a restart. It chooses the queue and priority attributes; Temporal's matching service holds the waiting tasks.
